_provenance: Producer fixtures: each envelope was built by mx-gateway's own code at origin/main a5f34b1 (2026-10-19), not written by hand: validateOperationQuery (spapi_measured_rule), the spapi-call-service unknown-operation throw (spapi_unknown_operation), preflightAdsRequest (ads_not_an_id), classifyAmazonError(...).toEnvelope() (spapi_bad_request, ads_throttled), SpApiError.toEnvelope (unknown), WalmartError.toEnvelope (walmart_unknown_operation, walmart_bad_request), and the routes' own schema-miss envelope around callSchema / walmartCallSchema.safeParse issues (route_spapi_schema_miss, route_walmart_schema_miss). One input is illustrative: walmart_bad_request's `walmart` body is an example of Walmart's 4xx body, wrapped the way connect-client.ts wraps it. Regenerate them the same way when the gateway contract changes; do not edit them by hand.

spapi_measured_rule.friendly: Operation fulfillment_inbound.get_shipments needs at least one of query.ShipmentStatusList or query.ShipmentIdList when query.QueryType=DATE_RANGE.
spapi_measured_rule.fix: Amazon: "At least one of ShipmentStatusList and ShipmentIdList must be provided" (3 in the P0 window). Reference: https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/fulfillment-inbound-api-v0-reference. Nothing was sent to Amazon.

spapi_unknown_operation.friendly: Unknown operation 'pricing.get_item_offers'. List the catalog via GET /api/amazon/spapi/operations (or the amazon_spapi_operations tool).
spapi_unknown_operation.fix: List the catalog via GET /api/amazon/spapi/operations (or the amazon_spapi_operations tool) and use an operation id from it.

ads_not_an_id.fix: Poll the value of the `reportId` field returned by reporting.create_report. Values like "ok" or a status word (PENDING, COMPLETED) are not the id, and re-polling this one will never succeed. Nothing was sent to Amazon.

spapi_bad_request.friendly: Amazon rejected this SP-API request (HTTP 400, InvalidInput): Invalid granularityType. Fix the request and send it again; re-sending it unchanged will fail the same way. If MixShift's own operation catalog or docs led you to send it this way, that is a bug on our side worth reporting.

ads_throttled.friendly: Amazon is rate-limiting Amazon Ads API requests right now. Try again shortly.
ads_throttled.message: Received 429 from the Amazon Ads API.

walmart_unknown_operation.friendly: Unknown Walmart operation 'sp.list_campaigns'. Run walmart_ads_operations for the list.

walmart_bad_request.friendly: Walmart Connect rejected the request. See `walmart` for its message.
